[Intro: solo piano hook, soft pad]

[Chorus: high male tenor, piano only]
Save me a seat
Wherever you've gone
I've been keeping notes
It won't be long
There's so much to go over
Since you got up to leave
So save me a seat

[Verse 1: male rap, warm and steady, soft beat enters]
Your number's in my phone and I haven't got the nerve
Still pass your exit, still slow down on the curve
Your laugh's in every room I ever shared with you
I keep on turning round to tell you something new
We were kids with one bike and a single pair of skates
Shared a locker, shared a lunch, shared a couple bad mistakes
You stood up at my wedding, I stood up at your door
I didn't know that standing was the thing we'd both be for

[Chorus: high male tenor, drums and strings]
Save me a seat
Wherever you've gone
I've been keeping notes
It won't be long
There's so much to go over
Since you got up to leave
So save me a seat

[Verse 2: male rap, lighter, a smile in it]
The team is still terrible, your mother's doing fine
Your kid has got your stubbornness and I have given mine
The keys to your old pickup, he's driving it too fast
I told him all the stories and I told him they were facts
I'm not big on praying but I'm talking to the sky
Mostly it's the scores and what I should have said, and why
Every road we ever took, I'm taking it for two
And every time I'm laughing there's a part of it that's you

Oh, oh-oh
